summary: Cavite 3rd District representative with 9 principal-authored bills. Reviewed bills cover minimum wage co-authorship, a constitutional convention, and anti-discrimination in employment.
caveat: Too few ideologically relevant bills to score any dimension; no votes or statements reviewed.

economic.label: Insufficient evidence
economic.rationale: Only labor evidence found (co-authored minimum wage).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08081, HB00094 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Only equal-protection evidence (employment discrimination against rehabilitated persons, HB06716).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB06716 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Only a constitutional convention bill (HB05870), a neutral process issue.
